[P2] Revisit the test strategy for the public types

The PR adds three public types without adding tests, and existing tests do not reference them. The reported suite run therefore does not protect their defaults, construction constraints, or session method signature. This violates **AGENTS.md — Testing Requirements** and **CONTRIBUTING.md — Contributing via Pull Requests, item 3**, which require related unit tests and e2e coverage for public API changes. Following **rule 9**, please return to the design phase (**rule 8, step 6**) and agree the required test coverage for this API increment.
